question_text: An athlete runs one round of a circular track of diameter 100 m in 20 sec. What will be the displacement after 1 minute & 10 sec respectively?
explanation: Diameter = 100 m (radius = 50 m). One round takes 20 s, so displacement after every 20 s = 0. After 1 minute (60 s) = 3 complete rounds → displacement = 0 m. After 10 s = half a round → displacement = diameter = 100 m. Hence 0 m & 100 m.
subject: Physics
image_description: A circle with a vertical diameter line labelled 100 m, representing the circular track.

question_text: A circular track has radius = 200 m and 1 revolution takes 20 sec. After 1:30 min, the displacement is?
explanation: 1 rev = 20 s. Total time = 1:30 min = 90 s. In 80 s = 4 complete revolutions → displacement = 0 m. The remaining 10 s = half a revolution → displacement = 2 × radius = 200 × 2 = 400 m.
subject: Physics
image_description: A circle with a vertical double-arrow line labelled 200 m and a horizontal radius line labelled 200, representing the circular track.

question_text: An athlete one round of a circular track of diameter 100m in 20sec. What will be the displacement after 1 minute & 10s, respectively.
explanation: Total time = 1 minute 10 seconds = 70 seconds. Time for one revolution = 20 seconds. Number of revolutions = 70 / 20 = 3.5 revolutions. After 3 full revolutions, the displacement is 0. The remaining 0.5 revolution (half a revolution) results in a displacement equal to the diameter of the track. Given diameter = 100m, the displacement is 100m.
subject: Physics

question_text: Circular track, radius = 200m. 1 revolution 20 sec. after 1:30 min displacement = ?
explanation: Total time = 1 minute 30 seconds = 90 seconds. Time for one revolution = 20 seconds. Number of revolutions = 90 / 20 = 4.5 revolutions. After 4 full revolutions, the displacement is 0. The remaining 0.5 revolution (half a revolution) results in a displacement equal to the diameter of the track. Given radius = 200m, diameter = 2 * 200m = 400m. The displacement is 400m.
subject: Physics

question_text: He had been vehement in opposing the idea.
